name: Gladly
oneLiner: Customer service platform, now positioned as an agentic commerce platform ('Commerce AI for every customer moment'), that keeps one lifelong conversation per customer across channels and adds Gladly AI.
bestFor: Mid-market and enterprise consumer brands, including hospitality, that run high-touch service across voice and digital channels.

updates.text: Announced agentic commerce capabilities at its Gladly Connect Live conference: one AI system that handles sales questions (such as sizing) and service requests (such as exchanges) from pre-purchase discovery to post-sale retention.
Blog post describing the next version of the platform, where AI handles conversations, assists agents and resolves requests across channels.

features: One lifelong conversation thread per customer across voice, email, chat, SMS and social
Customer profile with full history and order data visible to agents
Gladly AI that answers and resolves customer requests across channels and hands off to staff with context
Team Assist: AI assistance for human agents during conversations
Self-service help center content used by the AI
Reporting on team performance and customer satisfaction
Travel and hospitality use cases: booking changes, cancellations, FAQs and service informed by loyalty status (https://www.gladly.ai/industries/hospitality-travel-cx/)

pricing.text: Custom pricing; the pricing page (gladly.com/pricing redirects to gladly.ai/pricing) publishes no prices or trial and leads to 'Get a Demo' and 'Contact sales'.

notes: Gladly's site and blog now also live at gladly.ai; the original Website link (gladly.com) was kept. Third-party price estimates (about $180-$210 per user per month, AI billed per resolved conversation) were not used because Gladly does not publish them. A third-party guide says Gladly AI hands off non-English conversations by default; not used. Vendor-reported case-study metrics left out. Homepage, pricing and hospitality pages fetched at gladly.ai 2026-11. JOANN is not used in reviews: the current homepage no longer lists it. G2 rating from a search snippet of the G2 product page (count varies between G2 pages).
pros: One conversation per customer across voice, email, chat, SMS and social, so context carries over
Gladly AI and human agents work from the same customer history
Travel and hospitality offering covers booking changes, cancellations and service by loyalty status

cons.text: No published prices; the pricing page leads to a demo and sales
No free trial listed; the pricing page offers a demo
Positioned as a 'retail-trained AI Commerce solution', and its hospitality page names no restaurants
Built for mid-market and enterprise consumer brands, so a small restaurant group may need less
